behaviour.publicRoute: POST only. GET and HEAD answer 405 with Allow: POST and no card data. One byte-identical 200 {"state":"unknown"} for every non-open answer: unknown or malformed token, withdrawn, expired, changed, role lost, real workspace, switch off and module missing. A 512-byte body bound. The token is read only from the POST body (query string and headers are ignored). Headers: no-store, no-referrer, X-Robots-Tag noindex nofollow, nosniff, JSON; no cookie; no logging of the body, token, hash or fragment. After the review fixes the transport checks (origin, content type, body bound) run BEFORE the switch check so the switch state is not observable.
behaviour.limiters: Create is limited per verified customer ('decision-card-customer:<issuer>:<verified subject>') and per client ('decision-card-owner:<client>'), applied AFTER the customer session is verified, through a hook inside the transaction. Withdraw is never limited. Public reads are limited per client ('decision-card-public:<client>'; malformed requests are keyed per client only) and per token digest. create requires acknowledged: true at the HTTP layer only.

acceptedAndRecorded: The per-token read allowance is shared by all visitors of one link: a mail scanner or a team opening the link can use it up and give a recipient a rate-limit answer. That answer reveals nothing about whether a card exists.
State and preview are not rate limited (signed-in customers only).
The rate-limit table keeps a keyed hash of the visitor address per hour, so page and owner copy must not claim that nothing at all is stored about visitors.
A rotation of AUTH_SECRET makes an exact create retry answer CHANGED. This is safe; a new card is needed.
acknowledged is enforced at the HTTP layer only.
The limiter spends its count on a separate connection, so a rolled-back create still uses one unit (same as the Books route).
A failed foundations ready gives a logged 503.
limits: The four failing integration tests (adapters, blob, scan-bypass need ClamAV; foundations backup restore needs pg_dump) fail in the sandbox and on main; CI is the proof for the exact head.
